reason: A Feishu/Lark gateway that connects conversations to persistent DeepSeek Harness agent sessions and supports replies, interactive approvals, streaming updates, and optional proactive push.

summaries.zh: 将飞书私聊和群聊连接到持久化的 DeepSeek Harness 智能体会话，并支持消息回复、交互式卡片、流式进度和可选主动推送。
summaries.en: Connects Feishu private and group chats to persistent DeepSeek Harness agent sessions with message replies, interactive cards, streaming progress, and optional proactive push.

capabilities: Receives Feishu private and group messages
Routes messages to persistent DSH agent sessions
Runs the DSH agent with configured tools including bash, files, and subagents
Sends Markdown replies, interactive cards, reactions, and proactive Feishu pushes
Exposes optional authenticated HTTP endpoints for health, session overview, and proactive push
